title: Valve apparatus and vacuum handling apparatus having a valve apparatus

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The vacuum generating device 104 can, for example, be an electrical vacuum generating device 104 , such as a blower.
features.note: The reference discloses an electrical vacuum generating device, but it is not explicitly stated to be 'in the housing' of the valve apparatus, but rather connected to it.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: The vacuum handling apparatus 100 comprises one or more—in the example, four—gripper devices 102 - 1 , 102 - 2 , 102 - 3 , 102 - 4 . Each gripper device 102 - 1 , 102 - 2 ,
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum handling apparatus with gripper devices comprising a valve apparatus and a suction grip device, but does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' or 'suction plate' as defined in the feature.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: The suction opening is fluidically connected to a suction connection used for connecting a suction grip device.
features.note: The reference discloses a suction opening connected to a suction grip device, which implies a suction chamber, but does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' or 'suction plate' as defined in the feature.

claims.note: This reference describes a valve apparatus for vacuum applications and a vacuum handling apparatus, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or for use with a suction plate.

claims.quote: The vacuum handling apparatus 100 also comprises a central vacuum generating device 104 that is common to all gripper devices 102 - 1 , 102 - 2 , 102 - 3 , 102 - 4 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generating device, but it does not describe a housing with a grip portion for gripping the grip unit, nor does it explicitly state the vacuum generating device is electrically operated.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference describes a valve apparatus for vacuum applications and a vacuum handling apparatus, but it does not mention a grip portion or a sound-damping device within it.
This reference does not describe a grip portion or any lining with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a vacuum generating device but does not mention it being arranged in a 'first housing portion' of a grip unit's housing.
This reference does not describe a first housing portion or any sound-reducing device or material within it.
The reference describes a valve apparatus for vacuum applications, not a grip unit with an elongated grip portion or first/second housing portions as described in the claim.
The reference does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip unit with bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air from a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference does not disclose a battery coupling point on a housing or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
The reference does not mention air baffles or directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The invention also relates to a vacuum handling apparatus ( 100 ) comprising a valve apparatus ( 10 ).
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum handling apparatus.
The reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it and extending around it.
The reference does not disclose a 'grip unit according to claim 1' as claim 1 is not provided in the context of this reference.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.

This reference does not describe a grip unit having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate to generate a vacuum between the suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a valve apparatus for vacuum applications and a vacuum handling apparatus, which is a related field. However, it does not disclose the specific features of a grip portion, sound damping, or the detailed structure of a suction plate as described in the subject invention.
